fear_greed.commentary: The index sits in fear at 27 after Monday's close, up from Friday's extreme-fear reading of 21 but still below 30 a week ago and 37 a month ago.

markets.summary: Stocks snapped back Monday as Anthropic's IPO filing revived the AI trade: the S&P 500 rose 0.70% to 7,676.77, the Nasdaq gained 0.82% to 26,169.38 and the Dow added 0.28% to 52,361.58, with the Philadelphia semiconductor index up about 3% and Nvidia up 2.4%. Small caps lagged slightly, with the Russell 2000 up 0.38% to 2,786.42 and still below its 40-week average. The 10-year Treasury yield held near 4.99% ahead of Wednesday's Fed decision, where a hold is about 90% priced, after a soft $69 billion two-year note auction. Gold futures rebounded 0.8% to $4,038.40 from Friday's three-month low as oil eased, and silver rose 0.7% to $54.11, though both remain below their 40-week averages. Thursday brings Q3 GDP and September PCE inflation, and Alphabet, Microsoft and Amazon report this week.

stories.headline: Nvidia jumps on Anthropic filing, SpaceX GPU debt and a Morgan Stanley top-pick call

stories.headline: Cadence launches chip-design AI models built on Nvidia's Nemotron
stories.summary: Cadence's new Maestro suite, built partly on Nvidia's open-weight Nemotron model, lets chipmakers run design AI in-house, contrasting with rival Synopsys' OpenAI deal.

stories.headline: Cameco heads into Oct. 30 earnings about 42% below its record

weather.summary: A Pacific trough pushing a front across the Northwest brings rain and high-elevation snow to the Northwest, northern Rockies and Intermountain West through Wednesday, while low pressure moving from the central High Plains toward the Upper Mississippi Valley spreads rain across the Plains and possible wet snow in the northern Plains into Tuesday morning. Scattered storms linger on the southern High Plains, Gulf moisture keeps showers going in east Texas, and heavy rain could cause flash flooding in east-central and southeast Florida through Wednesday.
